therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of androgen-driven prostate cancer cell growth
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Proportion of patients showing PSA nadir

results.effect_size: 83% of patients achieved PSA nadir (95% CI: 63-95%)
results.target_engagement_evidence: PSA nadir achieved in 83% of patients, median time to PSA nadir 77 days
biomarker_changes: Median 14% decrease in prostate volume from baseline to nadir
Median 7% decrease in prostate volume from baseline to final visit
safety_signals: 12 patients reported study treatment-related adverse events
1 serious adverse event of prostate infection
results.dose_information: Single injection of 600 mg 2-HOF as controlled release depot formulation

context.duration: Maximum 6 months follow-up with assessments every 4 weeks
